name: The Cat
notes: A channel with a cat in it. No house, no rooms, no mention of either. Opened by /start-game.

name: A Place to Sleep
notes: The cat bed appears in the channel, and with it /look and /use.

name: Something to Play With
notes: The cat toy, /take and /inventory. Not built yet; defined here because content already waits on it.

name: A Craving
notes: The craving game, and nothing else. The cat wants a particular food today, and players guess it by putting emoji reactions on her messages. Numbered 3 so it can run on the QA servers with /qa-drop before beta. Renumbered 26 October.

name: The Door
notes: Was drop 3. The cat leads players into the Entryway: coat rack, the salmon stash behind it, front door, ceiling. One quest, feeding the cat. Renumbered 26 October; drops after 3 are numbered in tens to leave room between them.

name: The Rest of the Hall
notes: Was drop 4. The rest of the Entryway: intercom, shipping box and spice jars, mirror, stroller, shoes, booties, lumber and the ruined staircase. David's name first appears on the box's packing slip. Starts the staircase repair: 90 planks by default (config staircase_planks), one per player per day. Alexa and the bulletin board were held back on 29 October and sit at 99 until a later drop is picked.

name: The Ground Floor
notes: Was drop 5. Dining Room, Kitchen, Courtyard and Living Room with everything in them, the doors to them from the Entryway, the can opener, three more cat-food flavors, and the bottle and diaper scatter. The to-do list was held back on 30 October and sits at 99 until a later drop is picked, the same way Alexa and the bulletin board do. The kitchen tuna stash went the same day: the dining room sideboard holds tuna now rather than salmon, so salmon comes from the Entryway alone.

name: Upstairs
notes: Was drop 6. Upstairs Hallway, Bedroom and Nursery, reached only by the repaired grand staircase; the kitchen back stairs were deleted on 30 October. Meant to open on the staircase repair rather than by command; until that is built it is advanced like the rest.

name: The Last Door
notes: Was drop 7. The Secret Library and the two passages into it, per-player discovery as Phase 2e specifies.
